title: Assessment of reactor hydrodynamics and treatment effectiveness of secondary treated refinery wastewater in an airlift photobioreactor
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00144G, Paper
Prashant Sinha, Suparna Mukherji
This study presents the first application of an airlift photobioreactor using diesel-acclimatized microalgae for refinery wastewater treatment, achieving high pollutant removal efficiencies and enhanced biomass productivity.
